subject: POC scope expansion request — proposed re-baseline and next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@shopverb.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@shopverb.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:02:00Z
Subject: POC kickoff recap + next steps (ShopVerb)

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — great discussion. Per the call, here’s a concise recap and the proposed next steps so we have alignment before the trial starts next week:

Scope (agreed):
- Primary use case: product description generation for new SKUs (throughput target: 10K requests/day).
- Baseline acceptance criteria: mean latency < 400ms for 95th pct, BLEU-style content match >= 0.62 (per your seed prompts), and no PII leakage on the sample dataset.

Deliverables we committed to:
- Redwood: evaluation harness + initial eval dataset, deployment of model variant, monitoring dashboard and weekly syncs.
- ShopVerb: provide sanitized sample catalog (CSV), representative prompts, and a dedicated engineering point-of-contact for retrieval config.

Timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): data handoff and infra onboarding.
- Week 1: deploy trial model + smoke tests.
- Weeks 2–4: evaluation period and weekly checkpoints.

Next steps (action owners):
- Samir: share sanitized CSV + example prompts (by 2026-06-09).
- Monica: I’ll send the evaluation plan & acceptance criteria spreadsheet (attached) and proposed roll-in dates.
- Karthik: confirm model variant and infra notes for the trial.

I attached the evaluation plan we’ll use to compute the success metrics (redwood-eval-plan-v2.xlsx). If anything above is off, flag it and we’ll update.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@shopverb.com>

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@shopverb.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap + next steps (ShopVerb)

Thanks Aditya — quick clarification after syncing internally. Two asks from our product team that would change the POC scope slightly:

1) Add a secondary use case: short-form product titles auto-generation for category pages (this is lower latency but sensitive to factuality). We want to include ~5K title-generation calls in the evaluation sample.
2) For acceptance criteria, in addition to BLEU-like match, we want a factuality score target (synthetic QA on product attributes) with a pass rate >= 88%.

Can you confirm:
- Whether adding this second use case requires extra infra or a different model config?
- If this changes timeline (we may need an extra week for evaluation), and any changes in ownership / deliverables.

If we can get a short note on impact by EOD tomorrow, we’ll confirm the data handoff.

Regards,
Samir Khanna
Product Lead — ShopVerb
samir.khanna@shopverb.com

[External: ShopVerb is a ShopTech Marketplace company]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@shopverb.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@shopverb.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap + next steps (ShopVerb)

Samir — thanks for the quick turn. Short answer: adding the title-generation use case is feasible, but it does change the evaluation plan and we recommend a phased re-baseline to keep trial risk low. Proposed re-baseline below:

Proposed phased approach (minimizes churn):
Phase A (original scope) — product description generation
- Timeline: Week 0–1: onboard + deploy; Weeks 2–3: evaluation window.
- Success criteria: latency < 400ms (95th), content match >= 0.62, no PII leakage.

Phase B (title generation add-on) — added mid-trial
- Timeline: Week 3–4 (starts after Phase A smoke pass); two-week evaluation window.
- Success criteria: factuality pass rate >= 88%, mean latency target < 250ms (95th).
- Notes: will run on same model family but we recommend enabling a tighter retrieval context and a light-weight reranker for factuality checks.

Impact on timeline & ownership:
- We expect +1 week overall (i.e., extend trial by one week) to accommodate Phase B evaluation and validation.
- Redwood: deliver updated eval harness and helper reranker config (Monica lead).
- ShopVerb: provide title-generation seed examples + attribute map (Samir lead).

Attachments: I’ve updated the evaluation plan to include Phase B sections (redwood-eval-plan-v2.xlsx). Karthik, can you confirm the infra notes below and whether the reranker needs a separate instance?

If that all sounds ok, we’ll prepare a short SOW addendum and a revised schedule.

Best,
Aditya

[Attachment: redwood-eval-plan-v2.xlsx (updated)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@shopverb.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T12:46:00Z
Subject: Re: POC scope expansion request — infra notes + feasibility

Quick feasibility notes from the infra/SE side:
- Model variant: run base LLM-XL quantized FP16 for both tasks; it meets both latency targets with our batching profile.
- Reranker: lightweight bi-encoder reranker should run on the same GPU host; no separate dedicated instance required unless you want dedicated autoscaling (ShopVerb said throughput is modest).
- Retrieval: to get the factuality pass rate, we need the attribute map and an indexed product attribute store (we can accept an S3 CSV + small Glue table). Indexing + retrieval config will take ~2 full engineer-days (SE) before Phase B evaluation starts.
- Token cost: expect +18% token usage vs the original plan because of title micro-prompts and reranker queries — rough estimate included in the attached notes.

I attached a short SE notes file with the exact config snippets and the change log (se_adapter_notes.md). If ShopVerb wants to cap spend during the trial we can gate Phase B until approval.

-Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment: se_adapter_notes.md (TXT)]

Thanks — that all makes sense and aligns with internal priorities. We approve the Phase A + Phase B phased approach on the conditions below:

Conditions:
- One-week extension to end of trial to cover Phase B evaluation (agreed).
- Redwood to provide a short SOW addendum & revised schedule (we’ll sign electronically).
- Cost cap for trial: please provide an updated rough estimate (including the +18% token usage) before Phase B starts.

Action items I’ll take:
- Share title-generation seeds and the attribute map by 2026-06-11.
- Review the SE notes and flag any blockers.

Please go ahead and draft the SOW addendum and a revised schedule; Monica / Aditya, if you can loop procurement contacts once ready, we’ll accelerate signature.

Appreciate the fast turnaround here.
